title: WPA Protocolometry Pilot 20 Selection Protocol
purpose: Select a balanced, non-cherry-picked real-institution pilot for methodological validation without creating a public ranking.
eligibility: At least one Tier A or Tier B source supporting institutional identity
Peer type assigned or explicitly marked review-required
No unresolved duplicate/successor conflict that could materially distort scoring

sampling_objectives.regional_balance: Include institutions from all five global coverage regions where the eligible pool permits.
sampling_objectives.peer_type_balance: Include STATE_FOREIGN_SERVICE, INDEPENDENT_PROTOCOL, UNIVERSITY_LINKED and INTERNATIONAL_TRAINING where sufficiently represented.
sampling_objectives.institution_size_balance: Include small specialist and larger state-linked bodies; size itself is not a scoring variable.
sampling_objectives.evidence_density_balance: Include both high-transparency and lower-transparency cases to test NE/evidence-coverage behavior.
sampling_objectives.maturity_balance: Include long-established and newer institutions where public evidence permits.
sampling_objectives.selection_bias_control: Do not select institutions because they appear likely to score highly or poorly.

selection_method: Build the eligible pool before seeing any composite scores.
Stratify first by region and peer type.
Within strata, prefer coverage diversity and evidence-profile diversity rather than prestige.
Freeze Pilot 20 institution IDs before independent scoring begins.
prohibited_selection_logic: No selection based on expected score
No exclusion merely because evidence is inconvenient or incomplete
No retroactive sample change after seeing comparative results except documented entity-resolution failure
publication_rule: Pilot membership and results remain methodological-validation material until a later publication decision. Pilot 20 does not constitute a ranking release.
